_comment: Rates are read at race time - edit freely.
vcpus/mem_gib are NOT taken from this file when anything better is known.
Resolution order, recorded per result as cost.basis:
1. requested - the SDK let us pin cpu/memory AND the vendor bills on the request
2. measured  - cgroup limits observed inside the sandbox by the environment probe
3. assumed   - the default_* values below, i.e. nobody actually knows
The report and dashboard label assumed rows, because an assumed cost column
is a restatement of runtime, not a price.
billed_on tells the cost model which rung applies:
requested-resources - vendor charges for what you asked for (Modal)
template-tier       - size comes from the template/image you launched (E2B)
verified_on is the date a human last checked the rate against the vendor's
price page. Anything older than ~90 days is flagged in the report.

e2b.source: project default supplied in spec - NOT checked against e2b.dev/pricing; memory is billed separately in reality, so this row understates cost

daytona.source: project default supplied in spec - NOT checked against daytona.io/pricing; Daytona meters CPU, memory and disk separately, so this row understates cost

modal.source: modal.com/pricing Sandboxes tier: $0.00003942/core/sec (1 core = 2 vCPU) => $0.070956/vCPU-hr; memory $0.00000667/GiB/sec => $0.024012/GiB-hr
